label: SYNTHETIC-DATA EXPERIMENT: metrics reflect patterns deliberately embedded by the synthetic generator. They are not evidence of real customer behavior or of real-world recommendation effectiveness.
note: Derived summary of the frozen Phase 3 report (synthetic-data experiment). The frozen report and manifests remain the authoritative record. Brackets are across-seed Student-t 95% intervals over 10 seeds; seed counts are within-seed paired-bootstrap CIs excluding 0.
limitations: Synthetic data only; no evidence about real customers or banking systems.
One SASRec training seed: initialization variation not measured; 10 seeds are 10 datasets.
Small NBP training sets and few within-session NBP cases.
Training histories are shorter than validation/test histories (temporal shift).
Bit-identical reproduction shown only on the same runtime (GPU, CUDA/torch build, threads).
